edits.new:
Every operation is one hop with a 2 s client budget (DP-11, ADR-020). rwb-decision's approval is read when a version is loaded or approved and not on the run path, so the run path holds no synchronous read of another service for the level.

Contract version: each consumed operation is fixed at its /v1 path; the version label is not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P10-AD020-CON-23).

Reference data: the lists read are LOV-DECISION (step, BR3), LOV-AUTONOMY (mode, TC-P10-AD020-CON-01) and LOV-APPROVAL-LEVEL (approval_level, BR4); the parameters read are not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-P10-AD020-CON-20); the reference-data contract is DP-06 and DP-07.
